learning_outcomes.text: Understand and evaluate the applications and functions of the discussed machine elements.
Transfer the acquired knowledge to other machine elements.
Independently select, dimension, and integrate suitable machine elements for a design into the overall construction.

Apply calculation and design methods in the field of machine elements and integrate and link them meaningfully with their knowledge of statics, strength of materials, materials science, and design theory.
Apply the terminology of the subject and discuss the tasks accordingly with professional colleagues.

syllabus_topics: Springs (helical springs, disc springs, torsion springs)
Pins and bolts (load capacity, shear stress)
Welded joints (welding processes, seam types, seam shapes, calculation in mechanical engineering)
Riveted joints (rivet types, shear, bearing pressure)
